parameters.name: ComputeCategory
parameters.description: The category of computing power. Set the value to \`economy\` to query the price of an economy instance type.

parameters.name: Cpu
parameters.description: The number of vCPUs. For more information about the vCPU and memory specifications that are supported by ECI, see [vCPU and memory specifications](~~114662~~).

parameters.name: EphemeralStorage
parameters.description: The size of the temporary storage space. Unit: GiB.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The ECS instance type. For more information about the ECS instance types that are supported by ECI, see [ECS instance types supported by ECI](~~114664~~).

> If you set this parameter, the specified values for the Cpu and Memory parameters are ignored. The price of only the ECS instance type is returned.

parameters.name: Memory
parameters.description: The memory size. Unit: GiB. For more information about the vCPU and memory specifications that are supported by ECI, see [vCPU and memory specifications](~~114662~~).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~146965~~) to query the latest information about regions and zones.

parameters.name: SpotDuration
parameters.description: The protection period of the spot instance. Unit: hour. Default value: 1. A value of 0 indicates that no protection period is specified.

parameters.name: SpotPriceLimit
parameters.description: The maximum hourly price of the spot instance. The value can be accurate to three decimal places. This parameter is required when SpotStrategy is set to SpotWithPriceLimit.

parameters.name: SpotStrategy
parameters.description:
The preemption policy for the instance. Valid values:

- NoSpot: a regular pay-as-you-go instance.

- SpotWithPriceLimit: a spot instance for which you specify the maximum hourly price.

- SpotAsPriceGo: a spot instance for which the system automatically bids based on the current market price.

Default value: NoSpot.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~146965~~) to query the latest information about regions and zones.
